lines.text: Did you know? Pos is Latin for put.
Positive: put firmly, so sure or good.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus put?

words.mean: put firmly, so sure or good
words.ex: She always has a positive attitude.
I propose that we meet again next week.
The government imposed a new tax on sugary drinks.

publish.title: Pos root: positive, propose and impose
publish.value: Pos comes from Latin "ponere" (to put, to place). Words: positive, propose and impose. propose = pro + pos; impose = im + pos.
